arxiv-1906-07422.title: Probing the origin of ultra-high-energy cosmic rays with neutrinos in the EeV energy range using the Pierre Auger Observatory
arxiv-1906-07422.creator: The Pierre Auger Collaboration
arxiv-1906-07422.description: Abstract Neutrinos with energies above 10 17 10^{17} eV are detectable with the Surface Detector Array of the Pierre Auger Observatory. The identification is efficiently performed for neutrinos of all flavors interacting in the atmosphere at large zenith angles, as well as for Earth-skimming τ \tau neutrinos with nearly tangential trajectories relative to the Earth.

arxiv-2101-00717.title: Algorithmic Complexities in Backpropagation and Tropical Neural Networks
arxiv-2101-00717.creator: Özgür Ceyhan
arxiv-2101-00717.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Özgür Ceyhan. In this note, we propose a novel technique to reduce the algorithmic complexity of neural network training by using matrices of tropical real numbers instead of matrices of real numbers. Since the tropical arithmetics replaces multiplication with addition, and addition with max \max , we theoretically achieve several order of magnitude better constant factors in time complexities in the training phase.

arxiv-2207-08617.title: A generalization of Geroch’s conjecture
arxiv-2207-08617.creator: Simon Brendle, Sven Hirsch, Florian Johne
arxiv-2207-08617.description: Abstract . The Theorem of Bonnet–Myers implies that manifolds with topology M n − 1 × 𝕊 1 M^{n-1}\times\mathbb{S}^{1} do not admit a metric of positive Ricci curvature, while the resolution of Geroch’s conjecture implies that the torus 𝕋 n \mathbb{T}^{n} does not admit a metric of positive scalar curvature.

arxiv-2302-01870.title: Universality of the q =1/2 Orbital Magnetism in the Pseudogap Phase of the High- T c T_{c} superconductor YBa 2 ​ Cu 3 ​ O 6 + x \rm YBa_{2}Cu_{3}O_{6+x}
arxiv-2302-01870.creator: Dalila Bounoua, Yvan Sidis, Martin Boehm, Paul Steffens, Toshinao Loew, Lin Shan Guo, Jun Qian, Xin Yao, Philippe Bourges
arxiv-2302-01870.description: Abstract Several decades of debate have centered around the nature of the enigmatic pseudo-gap state in high temperature superconducting copper oxides. Recently, we reported polarized neutron diffraction measurements that suggested the existence of a magnetic texture bound to the pseudo-gap phase [Bounoua, et al . Communications Physics 5, 268 (2022)].

arxiv-2404-00447.title: Synthetic Dataset Generation and Learning From Demonstration Applied to Industrial Manipulation
arxiv-2404-00447.creator: Alireza Barekatain, Hamed Rahimi Nohooji, and Holger Voos
arxiv-2404-00447.description: Abstract I Introduction Shifting from a fixed production scheme to flexible production, a concept known as Mass Customization, raises nontrivial uncertainties when it comes to robotic automation. One source of uncertainty comes from the fact that the robot system will be in an unstructured environment, meaning that the robot’s perception needs to perform a more sophisticated task.

arxiv-2505-12475.title: Multi-Dimensional Phase Space Manipulation for Attosecond Electron Bunch Compression
arxiv-2505-12475.creator: Yuxin Cheng, Qiang Gu, Chao Feng
arxiv-2505-12475.description: Abstract Attosecond electron beams are essential for investigating ultrafast structural and electronic dynamics in matter with atomic-scale resolution. We propose a novel method that enables robust attosecond-level electron bunch compression. This method employs THz-driven linear energy chirping and multidimensional phase-space manipulation, effectively compressing the electron bunch and suppressing its arrival timing jitter.

arxiv-2509-12149.title: Superresolving Non-linear PDE Dynamics with Reduced-Order Autodifferentiable Ensemble Kalman Filtering For Turbulence Modeling and Flow Regulation
arxiv-2509-12149.creator: Mrigank Dhingra, Omer San
arxiv-2509-12149.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mrigank Dhingra, Omer San. Accurately reconstructing and forecasting high-resolution (HR) states from computationally cheap low-resolution (LR) observations is central to estimation-and-control of spatio-temporal PDE systems. We develop a unified superresolution pipeline based on the reduced-order autodifferentiable Ensemble Kalman filter (ROAD–EnKF). The method learns (i) a low-dimensional latent dynamics model and (ii) a nonlinear decoder from latent variables to HR fields; the learned pair is embedded in an EnKF, enabling simultaneous state estimation and control-oriented forecasting with quantified uncertainty.

arxiv-2601-05649.title: Statistical Foundations of DIME: Risk Estimation for Practical Index Selection
arxiv-2601-05649.creator: Giulio D’Erasmo, Cesare Campagnano, Antonio Mallia, Pierpaolo Brutti, Nicola Tonellotto, Fabrizio Silvestri
arxiv-2601-05649.description: Abstract High-dimensional dense embeddings have become central to modern Information Retrieval, but many dimensions are noisy or redundant. Recently proposed DIME (Dimension IMportance Estimation), provides query-dependent scores to identify informative components of embeddings. DIME relies on a costly grid search to select a priori a dimensionality for all the query corpus’s embeddings.

arxiv-2602-14349.title: Same Prompt, Different Outcomes: Evaluating the Reproducibility of Data Analysis by LLMs Thanks: We thank Monica Alexander and Jamie Stafford for helpful suggestions. We gratefully acknowledge the financial support of the Data Sciences Institute at the University of Toronto and NSERC Alliance. Cui c
arxiv-2602-14349.creator: Jiaxin (Allyson) Cui, Rohan Alexander
arxiv-2602-14349.description: Abstract We systematically evaluate the reproducibility of data analysis conducted by Large Language Models (LLMs). We evaluate two prompting strategies, six models, and four temperature settings, with ten independent executions per configuration, yielding 480 total attempts. We assess the completion, concordance, validity, and consistency of each attempt and find considerable variation in the analytical results even for consistent configurations.

pmc-10618660.title: Middle superior and anterior superior alveolar nerve injury following trauma to the maxillary sinus: a prospective clinico-radiographic evaluation
pmc-10618660.creator: Sathish Radhakrishna, Eashwari Narayanan
pmc-10618660.description: ObjectivesAnterior maxillary sinus wall fractures are common in all types of maxillofacial trauma. They can result in various complications, including injury to the surrounding nerves. Owing to its anatomy, trauma to the maxillary antrum can result in injury to the middle superior alveolar nerve (MSAN) and the anterior superior alveolar nerve (ASAN).

pmc-10624573.title: Search of inhibitors of aldose reductase for treatment of diabetic cataracts using machine learning
pmc-10624573.creator: Trevor Chen, Richard Chen, Alvin You, Valentina L Kouznetsova, Igor F Tsigelny
pmc-10624573.description: PurposePatients with diabetes mellitus have an elevated chance of developing cataracts, a degenerative vision-impairing condition often needing surgery. The process of the reduction of glucose to sorbitol in the lens of the human eye that causes cataracts is managed by the Aldose Reductase Enzyme (AR), and it is been found that AR inhibitors may mitigate the onset of diabetic cataracts.

pmc-10654534.title: Beyond radiologist-level liver lesion detection on multi-phase contrast-enhanced CT images by deep learning
pmc-10654534.creator: Lei Wu, Haishuai Wang, Yining Chen, Xiang Zhang, Tianyun Zhang, Ning Shen, Guangyu Tao, Zhongquan Sun, Yuan Ding, Weilin Wang, Jiajun Bu
pmc-10654534.description: SummaryAccurate detection of liver lesions from multi-phase contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) scans is a fundamental step for precise liver diagnosis and treatment. However, the analysis of multi-phase contexts is heavily challenged by the misalignment caused by respiration coupled with the movement of organs.

pmc-10706677.title: Evaluation of the Efficacy of UV-C Radiation in Eliminating Microorganisms of Special Epidemiological Importance from Touch Surfaces under Laboratory Conditions and in the Hospital Environment
pmc-10706677.creator: Anna Różańska, Monika Walkowicz, Małgorzata Bulanda, Tomasz Kasperski, Edyta Synowiec, Piotr Osuch, Agnieszka Chmielarczyk, Marina Sartini
pmc-10706677.description: Introduction: Healthcare-associated infections in the post-pandemic era are as important as they were before COVID-19. The dominant route of transmission of microorganisms in health care units is the contact route, for which hand hygiene is of cardinal importance, but also effective disinfection of touch surfaces. Traditional disinfection based on chemical compounds is sensitive to human errors.

pmc-10737703.title: QUALITY OF WORK LIFE FOR CARE AIDES IN CANADIAN LONG-TERM CARE HOMES BEFORE AND DURING THE PANDEMIC
pmc-10737703.creator: Unknown
pmc-10737703.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Canadian Long-term care (LTC) homes were profoundly affected by the COVID-19 pandemic influencing work outcomes of care aides (CAs) who provide most direct care in these homes. We compared CAs’ demographics and quality of work life (QWL) before and during the pandemic by conducting a repeated cross-sectional analysis of data collected in February 2020 (pre-pandemic) and December 2021 (21 months later) from a stratified random sample of urban LTC homes in western Canada.

pmc-11476964.creator: Yikun Mei, Elena Lakotsenina, Marie Wegner, Timon Hehne, Dieter Krause, Dani Hakimeh, Dongwei Wu, Elisabeth Schültke, Franziska Hausmann, Jens Kurreck, Beatrice Tolksdorf

pmc-11650131.title: Nutritional value of seven demersal fish species from the North Atlantic Azores archipelago
pmc-11650131.creator: Joana Filipa Furtado Goulart, Alexandre Correia Pereira, António Manuel Barros Marques, Inês do Carmo Alves Martins
pmc-11650131.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Valorization of azorean demersal fish species must focus quality. This study aims to assess the nutritional value, sodium content and fat quality index of seven commercially relevant demersal fish species from the Azores Region: blackspot seabream (Pagellus bogaraveo), blackbelly rosefish (Helicolenus dactylopterus), splendid alfonsino (Beryx splendens), alfonsino (Beryx decadactylus), forkbeard (Phycis phycis), offshore rockfish (Pontinus kuhlii) and common mora (Mora moro). Moisture, ash, crude protein, total sugars, total fat, fatty acid profile, sodium and salt content were assessed.

pmc-11676742.title: Anion-Exchange Membranes’ Characteristics and Catalysts for Alkaline Anion-Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells
pmc-11676742.creator: Fa-Cheng Su, Hsuan-Hung Yu, Hsiharng Yang
pmc-11676742.description: This work aims at the effects of anion-exchange membranes (AEMs) and ionomer binders on the catalyst electrodes for anion-exchange membrane fuel cells (AEMFCs). In the experiments, four metal catalysts (nano-grade Pt, PtRu, PdNi and Ag), four AEMs (aQAPS-S8, AT-1, X37-50T and X37-50RT) and two alkaline ionomers (aQAPS-S14 and XB-7) were used.

pmc-12681956.title: Future-Proofing the Oral Health Workforce: Evidence From Four Low- and Middle-Income Countries on Training Needs in Dental Public Health
pmc-12681956.creator: Abhishek Mehta, Manu Mathur, Richard Watt, Carol C Guarnizo-Herreño, Regina J Mutave, Paulo S Goes, Barsha P Deka, Shehnaz Khan, Michelle Stennett
pmc-12681956.description: Background: The dental public health workforce in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) faces challenges including limited resources, a shortage of personnel, uneven distribution, and inadequate training opportunities. Obsolete educational frameworks and regulatory barriers exacerbate the problem further. A training needs assessment (TNA) is a crucial exercise to identify gaps in the current training landscape before instituting any capacity-building initiatives.

pmc-12860069.title: A mouse model of classical trigeminal neuralgia via intradural compression of the trigeminal nerve
pmc-12860069.creator: Mostafa W. Abdulrahim, Yanxia Chen, Sumil K. Nair, Qian Xu, Yaowu Zhang, Oishika Das, Ryan Gensler, James Feghali, A. Karim Ahmed, Christopher M. Jackson, Judy Huang, Youssef G. Comair, Chetan Bettegowda, Xinzhong Dong, Risheng Xu
pmc-12860069.description: IntroductionTrigeminal neuralgia (TN) is a debilitating orofacial pain condition that adversely affects quality of life. Although heterogeneous, the most common form of TN is classical TN, characterized by paroxysmal bouts of pain in response to otherwise innocuous stimuli. It is believed that classical TN results from neurovascular compression of the trigeminal nerve.

pmc-13500865.title: 去泛素化酶USP30通过调控MFN2泛素化减轻脑出血所致脑损伤
pmc-13500865.creator: 静 赵, 正 蒋, 春丽 陈
pmc-13500865.description: 目的脑出血是一种致残率和病死率均较高的脑卒中类型。线粒体功能障碍在脑出血后继发性脑损伤中发挥重要作用，保护线粒体功能被认为是一种潜在的治疗策略。泛素特异性蛋白酶30(ubiquitin-specific protease 30，USP30)是一种定位于线粒体外膜的去泛素化酶，在调控线粒体稳态中具有重要作用。本研究旨在探讨USP30在脑出血后的作用及其潜在分子机制。方法采用血红素诱导的SH-SY5Y细胞模型和Ⅳ型胶原酶诱导的大鼠脑出血模型开展体内外实验。体外实验：将SH-SY5Y细胞分为对照组、血红素处理24 h组和血红素处理48 h组，采用蛋白质印迹法和免疫共沉淀(co-immunoprecipitation，Co-IP)检测线粒体融合蛋白质2(mitofusin 2，MFN2)表达及其泛素化水平。为验证USP30过表达效率，将未接受血红素处理的SH-SY5Y细胞分别转染空载体或USP30-Flag质粒48 h，分为control+vector组和control+USP30组，采用蛋白质印迹法检测USP30蛋白表达。随后将细胞分为对照组、血红素组、血红素+空载体组和血红素+USP30过表达组，后2组均在USP30-Flag质粒或空载体转染48 h后给予血红素处理。采用细胞计数试剂盒8法检测细胞活力，采用三磷酸腺苷(adenosine triphosphate，ATP)、活性氧(reactive oxygen species，ROS)及MitoSOX试剂盒评估线粒体功能，采用Mito-Tracker染色和透射电子显微镜观察线粒体形态，并采用蛋白质印迹法和Co-IP检测相关蛋白质表达及MFN2泛素化水平。体内实验：将大鼠分为假手术组和脑出血3 d组，采用蛋白质印迹法和Co-IP检测血肿周围组织中MFN2表达及其泛素化水平。随后将大鼠分为假手术组、脑出血组、脑出血+腺相关病毒(adeno-associated virus，AAV)-NC组和脑出血+AAV-USP30组，后2组均于脑出血建模前20 d经侧脑室注射AAV-USP30或AAV-NC。于脑出血后第3天采用改良Garcia评分评估神经功能，采用苏木精-伊红(hematoxylin and eosin，HE)和末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶dUTP缺口末端标记法(terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick end labeling，TUNEL)染色评估组织学损伤及细胞凋亡，采用ATP和ROS水平检测、ATP5H免疫荧光和透射电子显微镜分别评估线粒体功能和超微结构，并采用蛋白质印迹法和Co-IP检测相关蛋白质表达及线粒体MFN2泛素化水平。结果体外实验中，与对照组相比，血红素处理24和48 h后，SH-SY5Y细胞中MFN2泛素化水平显著升高，而MFN2蛋白表达显著降低(均P<0.01)。与血红素+空载体组相比，USP30过表达显著提高SH-SY5Y细胞活力，降低细胞内ROS及线粒体ROS水平，增加ATP含量，并减轻线粒体碎片化及超微结构损伤(均P<0.05)。同时，USP30过表达降低MFN2泛素化水平、上调MFN2和B细胞淋巴瘤-2蛋白(B-cell lymphoma-2，Bcl-2)表达(均P<0.05)，下调Bcl-2相关X蛋白(Bcl-2-associated X protein，Bax)和cleaved caspase-3表达(均P<0.05)。体内实验中，与假手术组相比，脑出血后第3天大鼠血肿周围组织中MFN2泛素化水平显著升高，而MFN2蛋白表达显著降低(均P<0.01)。与脑出血+ AAV-NC组相比，AAV-USP30显著改善神经功能缺损，减轻血肿周围组织学损伤，减少TUNEL阳性细胞(均P<0.05)；同时降低ROS水平，提高ATP含量和ATP5H表达水平，并改善线粒体肿胀、空泡化及嵴结构破坏。AAV-USP30还降低MFN2泛素化水平、上调MFN2和Bcl-2表达，并下调Bax及cleaved caspase-3表达(均P<0.05)。结论脑出血急性期可伴随MFN2泛素化增强和蛋白质表达下降，可能参与线粒体结构和功能损伤。USP30通过抑制MFN2的泛素化及其降解，维持线粒体结构和功能完整性，从而减轻脑出血诱导的脑损伤。USP30可能是脑出血治疗的潜在分子靶点。 脑出血是一种起病急骤、病死率和致残率均较高的严重脑卒中类型，给患者和社会带来沉重负担。尽管脑出血仅占全球所有脑卒中的10%~15%，但其导致的脑卒中相关残疾负担却超过50%[1]。脑出血可导致2种类型的脑损伤：由血肿形成或扩大引起的原发性损伤，以及在此基础上发生的继发性损伤[2]。初始血肿大小及其进展是影响脑出血后原发性脑损伤的关键因素[3]。继发性脑损伤则由原发性损伤触发的一系列病理生理过程所致，是病情恶化的主要原因。研究[4-5]表明，脑出血后的继发性脑损伤受到神经炎症、氧化应激及细胞凋亡等因素的共同驱动，这些因素均显著影响患者的预后。因此，减轻继发性脑损伤对改善脑出血患者的预后和生活质量至关重要。近年来，大量研究[6-7]强调，血肿周围区域的能量代谢紊乱是脑出血后损伤级联反应的主要驱动因素，最终可导致神经元凋亡。因此，针对脑出血后神经元细胞的能量代谢功能障碍进行干预已成为减轻继发性脑损伤、改善患者预后的关键策略。 线粒体是关键的细胞器，能响应多种信号合成三磷酸腺苷(adenosine triphosphate，ATP)并维持能量稳态，以适应细胞环境和生理状态的变化[8]。作为有氧呼吸和能量产生的主要场所，线粒体在细胞代谢中发挥核心作用，其结构和功能受损与代谢紊乱直接相关。线粒体功能障碍是脑出血后继发性脑损伤发生的重要因素[9]，维持线粒体稳态对减轻脑出血后的继发性脑损伤至关重要[10-11]。近年来，线粒体动力学在调控线粒体结构与功能方面的作用日益受到关注[12]。线粒体分裂与融合是线粒体动力学调控的核心过程，其中多种鸟苷三磷酸(guanosine triphosphate，GTP)酶[如动力相关蛋白质1(dynamin-related protein 1，DRP1)、线粒体融合蛋白质1(mitofusin 1，MFN1)、线粒体融合蛋白质2(mitofusin 2，MFN2)和视神经萎缩蛋白质1(optic atrophy 1，OPA1)]发挥关键作用[13]。DRP1是调控线粒体裂变的关键因子，而MFN1、MFN2及OPA1则在维持线粒体融合过程中发挥重要作用[14]。在众多相关蛋白质中，MFN2是一种定位于线粒体外膜的动力蛋白质样GTP酶，其功能在中枢神经系统中备受关注。研究[15]发现，MFN2缺失可导致神经元线粒体碎片化，损害线粒体氧化呼吸链功能并破坏能量生成。此外，在皮层和海马中敲除MFN2会导致过度氧化应激和神经元细胞死亡[16]。相反，MFN2过表达在缺血再灌注损伤模型中表现出明显的神经保护作用，可减少缺血或缺氧诱导的神经元凋亡[17-18]。然而，MFN2是否能够作为减轻脑出血后神经元损伤的潜在治疗靶点，仍有待进一步阐明。 泛素特异性蛋白酶30(ubiquitin-specific protease 30，USP30)是一种定位于线粒体外膜的去泛素化酶[19]，可在一定程度上保护线粒体和过氧化物酶体免受损伤[20]。在氧糖剥夺/复氧(oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation，OGD/R)条件下，USP30能够抑制线粒体裂解，并阻止MFN2的泛素化及其降解[21]。然而，USP30在脑出血中的具体作用及其对脑出血后线粒体功能障碍的影响尚不明确。基于此，本研究拟探讨脑出血是否在体内和体外诱导MFN2的泛素化与降解，USP30过表达在脑出血体内外模型中是否能够减轻线粒体裂变，以及USP30是否通过调控MFN2的泛素化降解发挥神经保护作用。 材料与方法 伦理声明 本研究已获得中南大学动物护理与伦理审查委员会批准(审批号：2021117)。 实验动物 成年雄性SD大鼠(275~325 g)购自湖南斯莱克景达实验动物有限公司，饲养于湖南省人民医院中心实验室，环境条件受控(恒温25 ℃，相对湿度60%)。大鼠可自由获取食物和水，并维持12 h光照/12 h黑暗循环。实验过程中尽量减轻动物的痛苦。 体内脑出血模型的建立 参照文献[22]，采用注射Ⅳ型胶原酶的方法建立脑出血模型。简要步骤如下：大鼠经腹腔注射戊巴比妥钠(40 mg/kg)进行深度麻醉后，固定于立体定位仪上，经颅骨钻孔后将10 μL微量注射器插入右侧纹状体。随后，将溶解于2 μL 0.9%生理盐水中的Ⅳ型胶原酶0.
